user.title: Your club
user.description: Type the name of your club (or its 8-digit Ten'Up code).

cookie.title: Ten'Up session
cookie.description:
Ten'Up does not allow logging in with a password from an integration, so paste your session cookie.

1. Log in on tenup.fft.fr in your browser.
2. Open the developer tools (F12), tab Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox), then Cookies > https://tenup.fft.fr.
3. Copy the value of the cookie whose name starts with SESS and paste it below as `SESSxxxx=value`.

Club: {club} ({club_code})

reauth_confirm.title: Ten'Up session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Log in again on tenup.fft.fr and paste a fresh SESS cookie for {club} ({club_code}).

error.no_club: No club found, try another spelling
error.invalid_cookie: This does not look like a cookie (expected SESSxxxx=value)
error.invalid_auth: Ten'Up does not recognise this session, log in again and copy a fresh cookie
error.no_planning: Logged in, but the reservation grid of this club is empty (is it your club?)
